text: This staff report is about a matter which Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services has assessed an appeal from the owner of 17 Dilworth Crescent for front yard parking. Front yard parking at this location is not recommended because it does not meet the landscaping requirements of the City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 918. Additionally, the Code does not permit the licencing of a parking pad where the setback requirement from a fire hydrant cannot be met and where the proposed parking pad is not adjacent to the mutual driveway. The owner will be given an opportunity to make a deputation before Community Council.

The Toronto East York Community Council granted the appeal for front yard parking at 17 Dilworth Crescent, with the following conditions: 1. the parking area be a minimum of 2.2 metres in width and not exceed 2.6 metres and a minimum of 5.3 metres and not exceed 5.9 metres in length; 2. the applicant pay for the installation of the permanent ramp to service the parking space; 3. the applicant disconnect any downspouts, if feasible, or seek an exemption from Toronto Water in accordance with the requirements in Chapter 681-11(S); 4. the applicant provide the landscape features substantially in accordance with the plan as indicated in Attachment C attached to the report (March 09, 2018) from the Manager, Right of Way Management, Transportation Services, to the satisfaction of the General Manager, Transportation Services; and 5. the applicant pay all applicable fees and comply with all…
